lesson_summary: A confidently-written refuted verdict can itself be a false negative when the regrade checks the wrong layer. VS-02 was refuted on generic apimachinery empty-RV validation, but core Secrets opt out via AllowUnconditionalUpdate()==true and the apiserver populates empty-RV updates before validation runs, so a real kube-apiserver 1.33.0 accepted the operator empty-RV Update and overwrote the foreign Secret. Read the actual code path a claim traverses, including resource-specific strategy opt-outs.
rationale: Round-4 full re-run overturned the flagship rigor-save negative of the engagement via independent fresh-context regrade plus a real kube-apiserver envtest pos/neg control. Operator reviewed the R4 report drafts and approved promotion. PC-2 additionally confirmed in 4 repos (strong promotion signal).

sanitization.notes: Abstracted to the verify-of-verify discipline; synthetic PoC token values removed; repo labels retained as operator-internal provenance only.
